record.title: Revoked or closed-session trainees and interviewers retain closed-session draft, post-submission revision, and cross-scope read access via owner-only VaWebIntakeDraft checks
record.description: While docs/policy/web-intake.md (lines 89-93, digitva-9xn9.22) intentionally allows an interviewer whose real-project grant was removed to finish an in-flight browser draft (status == 'draft'), two source-verified authorization gaps in app/services/web_intake_service.py exceed that baseline because draft and submission helpers authorize via draft.user_id == user.user_id without verifying an active grant or active training session on (draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id). First, for training sessions (docs/policy/training-demo-project.md lines 194-197, 212), remove_participant (app/services/training_demo_service.py:2297) and close_training_session (line 2337 via _set_session_status at line 2324) deactivate the participant's VaUserAccessGrants while leaving the session's MasOrgUnit.is_active == True. When a trainee removed from or after closure of session S001 remains enrolled in another active session S002, training_scope.resolve('interview') (app/services/training_scope.py:61-84) and @role_required('interviewer') pass via S002, and list_drafts (app/services/web_intake_service.py:1853-1859), get_draft (lines 1862-1875), save_draft_sections (lines 2367-2474), and submit_draft (lines 2829-3063) only check draft.user_id == user.user_id, training_scope.keeps_project(draft.project_id) (True across all TRN01 sessions), and _require_live_org_unit(draft) (lines 2644-2680, True because MasOrgUnit.is_active remains True), allowing the trainee to read, edit, and submit drafts into closed/revoked session S001. Second, once an interview is already submitted (status == 'submitted', outside the in-flight draft exemption), find_own_submission (app/services/web_intake_service.py:3090-3096) checks only VaWebIntakeDraft.va_sid == va_sid, VaWebIntakeDraft.user_id == user.user_id, and VaWebIntakeDraft.status == 'submitted', omitting both _require_scope and training_scope.keeps_project. Consequently: (a) revise_submission (lines 3154-3442, calling find_own_submission at line 3224) and resubmit_browser_draft (lines 3943-3963) allow a real-project interviewer whose grant was revoked (while holding another interviewer grant) or a trainee from a closed session S001 (while in S002) to submit new revisions that overwrite case identity (_sync_case_identity at line 3378), activate a new payload version (ensure_active_payload_version at line 3380), and release active coder allocations (release_coding_for_changed_payload at line 3408); and (b) GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace?mode=view (app/routes/api/va_case.py:525-561) and GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/categories/<code>?mode=view (lines 841-895) call _authorize_view (lines 203-215) -> intake_svc.may_read_submitted_answers (app/services/web_intake_service.py:3099-3108), which returns True whenever find_own_submission(user, va_sid) is not None without checking active grants or training_scope, allowing revoked interviewers and closed-session trainees to continue reading submitted interview answers across the training/real boundary.
record.claimed_root_cause: app/services/web_intake_service.py#list_drafts (lines 1853-1859), get_draft (lines 1862-1875), save_draft_sections (lines 2367-2474), and submit_draft (lines 2829-3063) rely on draft.user_id == user.user_id and _require_live_org_unit (lines 2644-2680) without verifying that a TRN01 draft's org_unit_id belongs to an open training session with an active grant for the user, and find_own_submission (lines 3090-3096) checks only VaWebIntakeDraft ownership and status == 'submitted' without calling _require_scope(user, draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id) or training_scope.keeps_project(draft.project_id), propagating owner-only authorization into revise_submission (line 3224) and may_read_submitted_answers (line 3105).

trace.description: Authenticated POST /api/v1/intake/submissions/<va_sid>/revisions route gated by @login_required, @role_required('interviewer', 'interview_supervisor', 'admin'), and @training_scope.resolve('interview') accepts revision payload for va_sid.
Route delegates revision creation and authorization to intake_svc.revise_submission(current_user, va_sid, ...).

For a non-supervisor interviewer, revise_submission authorizes access to the submitted case solely by calling draft = find_own_submission(user, va_sid) without calling _require_scope(user, draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id).

find_own_submission queries VaWebIntakeDraft filtering only by va_sid == va_sid, user_id == user.user_id, and status == 'submitted', omitting active grant checks (_require_scope) and training project isolation (training_scope.keeps_project) (also used by may_read_submitted_answers at line 3105 from _authorize_view in app/routes/api/va_case.py:212).

revise_submission writes a new VaWebIntakeSubmissionRevision, updates active payload version (line 3380), and calls release_coding_for_changed_payload (line 3408) to release active coder allocations for a project/unit or closed training session where the user's grant was revoked.

evidence.description: get_draft checks draft.user_id == user.user_id and training_scope.keeps_project(draft.project_id) without checking whether a TRN01 draft's org_unit_id is in an active training session or active grant for the user.
_require_live_org_unit checks only MasOrgUnit.is_active (which remains True when a training session is closed or a participant is removed), not VaUserAccessGrants or MasTrainingSession.status.

submit_draft enforces draft.user_id == user.user_id, training_scope.keeps_project(draft.project_id), and _require_live_org_unit(draft), allowing submission into a closed training session org_unit_id when the user has another active session.

_set_session_status (called by close_training_session at line 2337) and remove_participant (line 2297) deactivate VaUserAccessGrants for the session without setting the session's MasOrgUnit.is_active to False.
find_own_submission filters VaWebIntakeDraft only by va_sid, user_id, and status == 'submitted', omitting _require_scope and training_scope.keeps_project.
may_read_submitted_answers returns True if find_own_submission(user, va_sid) is not None, bypassing both active grant checks and training_scope isolation.
revise_submission authorizes non-supervisor revisions via find_own_submission(user, va_sid) without verifying an active interviewer grant on (draft.project_id, draft.site_id, draft.org_unit_id).

_authorize_view falls back to intake_svc.may_read_submitted_answers(current_user, va_sid) on a route without @training_scope.resolve, permitting cross-scope and post-revocation reads of submitted interview answers.
Policy digitva-9xn9.22 explicitly allows finishing an in-flight browser draft after grant removal on a real project, but does not exempt post-submission revisions or closed training sessions.
Training policy specifies that closing a session or removing a participant stops its training grants and that training and real work never mix in the same request.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox execution is unavailable on this VM (predeclared promotion allowlist is empty), preventing live local execution of target-controlled Flask routes to record runtime evidence of closed-session draft submission, post-revocation revision, and cross-scope workspace view.

Owner policy confirmation is needed on whether decision digitva-9xn9.22 (docs/policy/web-intake.md:89-93, allowing an interviewer to finish an in-flight browser draft after grant removal) is strictly limited to unsubmitted real-project drafts (status == 'draft'), or whether post-submission reads/revisions via find_own_submission and in-flight drafts in closed TRN01 training sessions were ever intended to survive grant deactivation.

validation_plan.local: Inside an approved OS-enforced sandbox with an isolated test database (TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://minerva:minerva@minerva_db_service:5432/minerva_test_verifier_p3_06), run a non-destructive pytest test that: (1) enrolls a dummy trainee in two TRN01 sessions S001 and S002, creates an in-flight draft in S001 and a submitted interview in S001, closes S001 via training_demo_service.close_training_session, and verifies that with ?training=1 the trainee can still save/submit the S001 draft via POST /api/v1/intake/drafts/<id>/submit, revise the S001 submission via POST /api/v1/intake/submissions/<va_sid>/revisions, and view S001 answers without ?training=1 via GET /api/v1/va/<va_sid>/workspace?mode=view; and (2) gives a dummy interviewer grants on real units U1 and U2, submits a draft in U1, revokes the U1 grant while keeping U2 active, and verifies that POST /api/v1/intake/submissions/<va_sid>/revisions succeeds on the U1 case and releases an active coder allocation.
validation_plan.deployment: Confirm with the project owner that: (1) closing a TRN01 training session or removing a trainee must block further edits, submissions, and revisions of drafts belonging to that session's org_unit_id even if the user joins another training session; and (2) decision digitva-9xn9.22 applies only to unsubmitted in-flight real-project drafts (status == 'draft'), so find_own_submission / revise_submission / may_read_submitted_answers must require an active scope grant (or active training session) and enforce training_scope isolation.
